text:
I love you because you have

the parts of a woman in just the right places

and you are complete.

You lack neither petal,

nor scent, nor shadow.

Settled in your soul,

ready to be dew on the grass of the world,

moon milk on the dark leaves.

Perhaps you see me,

maybe, one day,

in a lamp turned off,

in a corner of the room where you sleep;

I am the stain, a dot on the wall,

some line that your eyes, without you,

go on looking at.

Perhaps you recognize me

as an ancient hour

when alone you ask, you question yourself

with your body shut and without an answer.

I am a scar that no longer exists,

a kiss already washed away by time,

one love and another you have already buried.

But you are in my hands and you hold me,

and in your hands I am ember, ash,

to dry the tears of yours that I cry.

In what place, where, at what untimely hour

will you tell me that I love you? It's urgent

because our eternity is running out.

Pick up my head. Keep the arm

with which I loved your waist. Don't leave me

amid your blood on that towel.

translation.title: I Love You Because You Have
